page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. In the left margin, beside the lines from "illi demùm" to "remissionem", a Greek marginal note with a short Latin tail ("totius Ps.").

main_text.p: tia & beneficio, ex animis rectis, recta opera proficiscantur. Hæc sunt quæ ex postrema Dauidis cohortatione colligere debemus.

Cùm autem multæ ac variæ doctrinæ nobis in hoc Psalmo propositæ fuerint, curemus ne illarum memoria nobis effluat, sed eas potius assidua cogitatione recolamus. Itaque (est enim illarum summa aliqua facienda) cùm Ἀνακε-φαλαί-ωσις to-tius Ps.illi demùm sint fœlices qui vera fide peccatorum remissionem amplexi sunt: agnoscamus peccata nostra, & eorum vero sensu perculsi, ad Dei misericordiam in Christo plenè nobis exhibitam recurramus, vt illius perfectissima iustitia induti, coram Dei oculis iusti reputemur. Hæc autem nostra per Christum iustifi-catio instar arboris feracis producat suos fructus, atque in primis animi puritatem atque integritatem, excussa illa hypocrisi quæ solet in animis nostris delitescere. Cùm verò ea sit, naturæ nostræ stupiditas, vt ægrè ad peccatorum confessionem adducamur, nunc saltem cùm sentimus Domini ferientis manum graviter in nos depressam, cùm his temporibus tot tantaque vulnera nobis inflicta sint, redeant in memoriam peccata præterita, eorumque veniā à Domini misericordia petamus: verásque lacrymas & gemitus ex intimo pectore proficiscentes coram paternis Dei oculis effundamus. Ne vanas excusationes pecca-tis nostris prætexamus, sed serió & ex animo fateamur innumerabiles offensas quibus in[?]

page.notes: Page number "154" is printed at top left in an old-style figure. Greek marginal note: accents and exact letters are uncertain, so the word is marked [?] in the Greek transcription below; the note is printed as Ἀνακε-φαλαί-ωσις, split over three lines in the margin, with "to-tius Ps." after it. The word "in" at the end of the main text is partly obscured by a superscript mark and is uncertain. The catchword "Dei" sits at the lower right below the last line. Printed hyphens are kept at line ends (pecca-tis, iustifi-catio, to-tius). Spacing after full stops is normalised where the scan shows a run-on (reputemur.Hæc, delitescere.Cùm).
